question: Both margins are computed on 24 months. How much of each one is the model, and how much is which 24 months were held out?
method: Paired bootstrap over test months, 10000 draws, seed 20260928. Every method is scored on the same resample. Reported twice: months drawn independently, and drawn in blocks of 3 consecutive months to allow for month-to-month dependence.
finding: The wider interval stays above zero, so the sign of this margin survives resampling. The wider interval spans zero, so this margin is not separable from nothing on 24 months.
